name: @grasp-os/core
description: The core Worker: sign-in, knowledge, Apps, workflows, model gateway, audit log

scripts.dev: vp -C ../web build --mode development && wrangler dev -c wrangler.jsonc -c ../connect/wrangler.jsonc --var DEV_SKIP_ROUTER_SECRET:true --var DURABLE_OBJECT_JURISDICTION:none
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply KNOWLEDGE --remote
scripts.db:generate: drizzle-kit generate --config src/db/core/drizzle.config.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config src/db/knowledge/drizzle.config.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config src/db/workspace/drizzle.config.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config src/db/audit-log/drizzle.config.ts
